title: The Last Three Places

The Last Three Places

A tour in seven boards. Nessa (P01), the community manager, has until the evening reception to secure the last memberships. Arun (P02), Bea (P03) and Felix (P04) have arrived as separate businesses; she wants them to leave as neighbours. This is a roof-level suite facing south: the co-working lobby (S01), the open office (S02) behind it, and the roof terrace (S03) behind that. Both thresholds are level. Late light meets the city's evening noise.

SHOTS (lens: wide-angle 24 mm, moderately wide 28 mm, normal 35 mm, slightly long 50 mm)

SHOT ONE - The offer
0-8 s: eye level, normal; truck east across the arrival side, turning the view from north-east at 0 s to north-west at 8 s, showing Nessa, Arun, Bea and Felix; finish looking diagonally back across the founders.

Face into the lobby from the arrival side, toward the office door in the far wall. The reception counter runs along the wall on your right. Against the opposite wall is a chair for each founder; a lamp accompanies every chair except the middle one, but the lamps themselves stand at the two ends of the counter. The end nearer the arrival side carries Arun's card, the middle carries Bea's, and the other end carries Felix's.

At 0 s Nessa stands at the arrival end of the counter, her back toward it, facing the founders. Arun is directly in front of her, facing her; Bea is at Arun's left and Felix at Bea's left, both facing the same way as Arun. At 2-2.5 s Nessa lifts Arun's card; a second after she starts lifting it, she begins handing it to Arun, finishing half a second later. She moves along the counter to Bea's card. At 4-4.5 s she lifts that card; the hand-over to Bea begins a second after the lift begins and lasts half a second. She repeats this for Felix: lift at 6-6.5 s, then hand-over a second after the lift begins, again lasting half a second. 

SHOT TWO - Commit to the walk
8-12 s: low, wide-angle; dolly out on the arrival side, behind Arun as he turns toward the office door, looking along his route toward that door, showing Arun, Bea and Felix; match cut on the card passing into Arun's hand.

At 8 s Nessa heads toward the office door. Half a second later Arun follows; Bea follows a second after Nessa leaves and Felix a second and a half after her. They turn away from the counter with their cards. Nessa crosses the threshold at 11.5 s. The founders reach it in arrival order: Arun crosses at 12.5 s, Bea a second later and Felix another second later. 

SHOT THREE - A place for each
12-18 s: eye level, moderately wide; follow Nessa from ahead of her into the open office, looking back at her as she walks toward the shared shelf; whip-pan cut carrying the lobby turn into her arrival.

Coming through the office door, face onward toward the terrace door in the far wall. A desk for each founder runs down the wall on your left, each with a chair on its approach side facing the desk. Arun gets the desk nearest the lobby, Felix the one nearest the terrace, leaving Bea the desk between them. On your right, the window comes before the shared shelf as you walk toward the terrace. The desk fronts face across your path toward that shelf. Nessa stops at the shelf at 18 s and faces it, with the window at her right.

recap.text: A dark-suited figure stands outside a grey car with a figure inside at the steering wheel, in front of tree-like shapes. The standing figure leans forward, reaches toward the car's rear wheel with a thin object, then steps back and puts their hands on their hips as the car begins to move forward and turn left, emitting smoke from its rear wheels.
Seen from directly above on a flat grey ground, the car drives in a tight clockwise circle around the standing figure in the centre, leaving circular dark tyre marks and a trail of grey smoke.

Seen from ground level again with tree-like shapes in the background, the car continues driving away to the left while curving, leaving tyre marks and smoke behind as the dark-suited figure stands on the right.

recap.text: A mannequin-like figure in a dark jacket stands on the left, facing right. A light-grey car with a second figure inside is to the right, emitting grey sphere-like dust clouds from its rear wheels.
The standing figure raises its left arm briefly as the car drives in a tight circle around the standing figure, passing in front of and then to the left of the standing figure.
From a top-down view, the car continues driving clockwise in a tight circle around the standing figure in the centre, leaving circular dark tyre marks and grey dust clouds on the ground.
Back at eye level, the car continues circling around the standing figure on the right as grey dust clouds fill the foreground.

A dark-suited figure stands on the left next to a stationary grey car, with another figure seated inside the driver's seat. The standing figure leans slightly forward, extending both arms toward the side of the car as exhaust smoke puffs from the rear.
The standing figure straightens up and lowers their arms while the car accelerates forward and turns sharply in front of them.
From an overhead view, the car drives in a tight clockwise circle around the standing figure, leaving circular dark tire marks and grey smoke clouds on the ground.
From a low ground-level angle, the car drives away into the distance toward a row of trees, leaving tire tracks and exhaust smoke behind.

A figure in a dark grey suit stands next to a grey car with another figure seated inside. The standing figure raises their right arm towards the car as the car slowly rotates clockwise around them. By 00:04.000, the standing figure lowers their arm.

Viewed from directly above, the grey car continues to spin in a tight clockwise circle around the standing figure, leaving concentric circular tire marks and puffs of grey smoke on the ground, flanked by rows of simplified green trees on the left and right.
Viewed from ground level behind the car, the grey car continues rotating clockwise past the standing figure in the suit.

Viewed from eye level, a figure in a dark suit stands in the center of a circular track on a paved area, surrounded by trees. A grey car with a driver inside drifts in a tight circle around the standing figure, emitting grey smoke from the rear. The standing figure turns in place to face the car as it circles, raising an arm slightly as the car passes in front.
Viewed from directly overhead, the car continues to drift clockwise in a tight circle around the standing figure inside the dashed circular markings, leaving a trail of grey smoke.
Viewed from a low angle behind the car, the car continues drifting around the standing figure while emitting smoke.
In a clearing surrounded by trees and rocks, a standing figure watches as a second figure drives a car-like vehicle in a circle around them, leaving dark rectangular tire tracks on the ground.

Seen from directly above, the figure in the car continues driving clockwise in a spiral around the standing figure in the center, leaving a trail of dark rectangular tracks and small spherical clouds behind the vehicle.
Seen from ground level again, the figure in the car continues driving around the standing figure and past the rocks.

In a clearing surrounded by trees and bushes, a figure in a dark outfit stands in the center while a grey car with a driver inside drifts in a circle around them, leaving dark circular tire tracks and kicking up clouds of dust. The standing figure turns in place, swinging their arms slightly to watch the car as it circles them.

Seen from directly overhead, the grey car continues to drift clockwise around the standing figure, following three concentric dark tire tracks on the ground and leaving a trail of dust behind it while the figure rotates in the center.
Viewed from ground level again, the grey car continues drifting around the standing figure, kicking up thick clouds of dust.
A tall figure in a dark suit stands next to a grey car with a smaller figure inside. Three low-poly trees are in the background. The standing figure leans back slightly and raises both arms forward.

The grey car begins driving in a tight circle around the standing figure, emitting grey puffs of smoke from its rear. The standing figure lowers its arms and rotates in place, facing the car as it circles.
Viewed from directly above, the car continues driving in a circle around the standing figure, leaving a dark circular ring on the grey ground.
Viewed from ground level again, the car stops circling and drives straight away towards the trees in the background, emitting grey smoke from the rear, while the standing figure watches it leave.
A dark-suited figure stands in the center while a grey car drives in a circle around them. Large grey spherical shapes appear and move along the car's path, and the figure turns to follow the car.

Viewed from directly above, the figure stands in the middle of concentric grey rings on the ground. The car continues driving clockwise around the figure, leaving a trail of grey spherical shapes and smaller floating spheres.
Viewed from ground level behind the car, the vehicle continues circling the standing figure as large grey spherical shapes expand near the figure.

A dark-colored mannequin figure stands outside on a flat gray surface next to a gray car, with green trees in the background. Another figure sits inside the car. The standing figure leans toward the car's window while the car begins driving in a tight circle around the standing figure, emitting gray oval shapes that resemble smoke puffs.
Viewed from directly above, the car drives clockwise along circular tracks around the standing figure in the center, continuing to emit gray oval shapes.
Viewed from ground level behind the car, the car continues driving along the circular track around the standing figure while emitting gray oval shapes and small gray cubes.
A tall figure in a dark suit stands outdoors near trees and rocks while a grey car spins around on the ground beside it; a seated figure in a dark suit moves along near the tall figure.
From a top-down view, the grey car drives in a circle around the two figures over flat grey rocks.
From a ground-level view, the tall figure and the seated figure remain stationary together while the grey car moves past them over the rocks.
